_readme: Per-run monitoring log, one file per calendar day (America/Phoenix), used to generate the Daily PDF Report. Distinct from cases.json, which is the permanent case/review-queue index.
_run_note: Twelfth scheduled run. 14 of 19 URLs served a catalog. Of the five that did not, one is a genuine coverage gap -- Flower Meadow Dream, refused by the egress proxy as on every day since 2026-09-16 -- and the other four (two Etsy shops, Bloomora's Facebook page, GCM Ranch's closed Etsy shop) have no open product feed at all and never serve a catalog. No new matches, no cases created, nothing held, no listing classified cut-roses-only. Your Roses held steady on its second day back, serving 1,665 products with all 72 of its cases re-verified. THE NOTABLE EVENT IS A DISAPPEARANCE, THE FIRST SINCE MONITORING BEGAN: Hillside Rose Farm's catalog fell from 153 products to 146, and one of the seven removed listings is tracked -- HILLSIDERO-005, Darlington, a Pending mark, first found 2026-09-21 and last confirmed present 2026-09-28. It is absent from the site's product feed under any title or handle and its product JSON returns 404. Its Last Verified was deliberately NOT advanced; the case keeps 2026-09-28 and carries a dated delisting note with the evidence and its limits. The rendered page could not be checked because the apex URL redirects to the www host, which this environment's proxy refuses, so what is established is that the listing left the catalog, not that the page is deleted. Nothing about why it came down is known and nothing should be inferred. 356 of 360 cases re-verified: the four not confirmed are Flower Meadow Dream's 3 (site unreachable) and this one.

sites.notes: Facebook page; facebook.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage, so the page was never reached. No open product feed exists for a Facebook page in any case.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage. The seller's own site (ergongzy.com) was crawled in full and carries the same catalog.

Not reached. Both www.myroseworld.com and myroseworld.com were refused by this environment's egress proxy at the CONNECT stage, so the request never reached the seller's server. This is our own network policy, not a block by the site. Unchanged since 2026-09-16. The site's 3 existing cases (MYROSEWORL-001..003) could not be re-verified and keep their 2026-09-16 Last Verified date.
Etsy shop closed (dormant). Roster entry retained per user instruction (2026-09-15); expected to stay inaccessible and not awaiting any decision.

Catalog shrank from 153 products to 146. One of the seven removed listings is a tracked case: HILLSIDERO-005 (Darlington, Pending) is no longer in the site's product feed and its product JSON returns 404. Its Last Verified stays at 2026-09-28, the last date it was confirmed present, and the delisting is recorded on the case. The rendered page could not be checked -- the apex URL redirects to the www host, which the egress proxy refuses. The site itself served its catalog normally.
Etsy storefront; etsy.com is blocked by this environment's network egress policy at the CONNECT stage.

Reached on the apex host after the www host was refused by the egress proxy. The Shopify feed returned HTTP 200 with an empty product array -- the store genuinely lists no products. Counted as checked, zero products.
Second clean run since recovering on 2026-09-28. Served 1,665 products again, unchanged, and all 72 of its cases re-verified present.

screenshot_limitation: Still no case has a screenshot on file -- same network-proxy limitation as prior runs (headless Chromium cannot complete a connection through this environment's egress proxy). Explained to the user in chat on 2026-09-14; awaiting their choice of approach (manual capture vs. Wayback Machine vs. environment-level fix).
